# requireGridRangeSameDimensions

<link-summary>Returns the range once both are known to be the same size, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireGridRangeSameDimensions() — Returns the range once both are known to be the same size, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireGridRangeSameDimensions(
  range1: GridRange,
  range2: GridRange,
  message?: string
): void;
```

The assertion form of `isGridRangeSameDimensions`. The default message states both sizes, so a mismatched copy says how far off it was.

## Parameters

| Parameter              | Type        | Description                                                                      |
| :--------------------- | :---------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `range1`               | `GridRange` | The first range.                                                                 |
| `range2`               | `GridRange` | The second range.                                                                |
| `message` _(optional)_ | `string`    | The message of the exception. A default stating both sizes is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`void` — the first range, unchanged.

## Throws

| Exception                   | Condition                             |
| :-------------------------- | :------------------------------------ |
| `InvalidGridRangeException` | the two ranges are not the same size. |

## Examples

### Guarding a copy

```javascript
const source = { startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 2, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 2 };
const target = { startRowIndex: 5, endRowIndex: 7, startColumnIndex: 5, endColumnIndex: 7 };

requireGridRangeSameDimensions(source, target); // => the source range
```
